summary.text: Jean Howard-Hill, an independent business executive, lost the November 3, 2026 election for the U.S. House in Tennessee's 3rd District to Chuck Fleischmann.
She was also an independent candidate for the same seat in 2024, when incumbent Charles J. Fleischmann defeated her and two other candidates.
No campaign website or public policy statements were found.

paragraphs.text: Jean Howard-Hill earned a bachelor's degree in urban planning and government from Wheaton College and a law degree from the University of Tennessee College of Law, according to Ballotpedia.
Her career experience includes working as a business executive at Howard-Hill Consultants.
She was an independent candidate for the same 3rd District seat in 2024, when incumbent Charles J. Fleischmann defeated her and two other candidates.
She received 0.4% of the vote to Chuck Fleischmann's 57.6%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
